readings.Aries: You have more capacity for tenderness than you show. Today someone needs to see it. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Taurus: Your loyalty is not the issue. The question is whether it's being returned in kind. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: You're very good at making things feel lighter. Someone around you needs weight acknowledged, not lifted. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Cancer: The mood that arrived without explanation is responding to something real. What is it? The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Leo: The person you're becoming requires a different audience than the person you were. Update accordingly. The first instinct was right.
readings.Virgo: You are harder on yourself than on anyone you love. Apply the same standard in both directions. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: You've been maintaining a relationship through effort rather than desire. Worth examining why. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Scorpio: The past is not gone — it's metabolised. What has your history made you capable of? This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Sagittarius: The question you're asking is good. The answer you're expecting is limiting the search. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: The coldness others perceive is not who you are. It is how you move through uncertain terrain. Let someone know. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Aquarius: The future you're pointing toward is more possible than yesterday. Take one step in its direction. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Pisces: You are more resilient than the softness suggests. Remind yourself. Something is about to become obvious.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
